organization.name: Algolia, Inc.
organization.notes: Company-founded 2012 verified in official company press history; private financing documented. Company announcement states July 28 2021 Series D led by Lone Pine with listed participants; blog republished 2023. Investors historical, not a current capitalization table; customers/integrations excluded.

pricingTiers.name: Grow
pricingTiers.unit: additional 1, 000 search requests in monthly usage
pricingTiers.notes: Lowest paid production usage offer:10 K search requests/month included, then$0.50/1 K; 100 K records included then$0.40/1 Krecords. Monthly billing, no synthetic fixed monthly/annual total.
Best value appears on multiple calculator cards; no unique Most popular/Recommended badge verified.

pricingTiers.name: Grow Plus
pricingTiers.unit: additional 1, 000 search requests in monthly usage
pricingTiers.notes: Closest organizational AI plan:10 Ksearch requests included, then$1.75/1 K; 100 Krecords included then$0.40/1 Krecords. No Business-named tier; record/recommend/crawler charges separate.

pricingTiers.name: Elevate
pricingTiers.notes: Custom volume-based enterprise offer requires annual contract and sales evaluation; no annual total published.

moats.claim: Developer libraries, search UI integrations and accumulated relevance/merchandising configuration create an ecosystem and workflow switching costs.

productReasons.claim: Neural Search combines keyword and semantic retrieval for queries that need meaning as well as exact terms.
Visual merchandising rules, synonyms and ranking controls let search teams curate results.
Search analytics and A/B testing support measuring relevance changes against user outcomes.
